in_english.name: Isam
in_english.meaning: a symbol of Islam, representing honesty and truthfulness
in_english.long_meaning: The name Isam is derived from the Arabic root "essem", meaning "to be straight" or "to be true". It symbolizes a person who adheres to the path of Allah and does not deviate from the truth. In Islamic tradition, Isam represents integrity, sincerity, and honesty. It is also a popular name in many Muslim cultures, including the Ottoman Empire, where it was borne by the famous hero İsmail Gazî.
